title: Handbook of the Measured Reach
summary: A handbook on stretching the space around the arm so blows land beyond the fist's true length.

title: A Primer on Distance Sense
summary: A primer on feeling the gaps and widths around the body and reading how far each foe stands.

title: Course in Shearing Strikes
summary: A course in cutting along a plane of space with the hand edge so a blow parts what it meets.

title: Handbook of the Bent Line
summary: A handbook on bending the line of a blow so it arrives from beside the guard and not before it.

title: Primer of Pocketed Hands
summary: A primer on slipping small things into a fold of space beside the body and drawing them out unseen.

title: Treatise on the Compressed Blow
summary: A short treatise on squeezing the space about a fist or limb until the blow lands dense and heavy.
